body: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial inference costs when processing long visual-textual sequences. While existing operation compression methods exploit modality-level redundancy, they largely treat computation within attention heads and shared feed-forward network (FFN) channels as unified units, leaving finer-grained redundancy underexplored. We find that redundancy varies both across modality-interaction paths within the same attention head and across visual and textual executions of the same FFN channel. Based on these findings, we propose Modality-aware Width-wise Operation Pruning (MWOP), which independently prunes visual-to-visual (V2V), text-to-visual (T2V), and text-to-text (T2T) attention paths within each layer, and separately selects FFN channels for visual and textual inputs. A first-order Taylor criterion guides the pruning process, with FFN importance re-evaluated after attention pruning and LoRA-based recovery training. To translate the resulting fine-grained sparsity into practical acceleration, we further develop path-sparse Triton attention kernels and compact visual-side FFN execution. MWOP preserves the token sequence while reducing attention and FFN computation, making it complementary to token compression and enabling simultaneous reduction of sequence length and per-token computation. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, MWOP alone achieves a 1.6× prefill speedup with 99.7% average performance retention across 12 benchmarks. Combined with two representative token compression methods, it further increases their prefill speedups from 2.0× and 1.9× to 2.9× and 2.7×, respectively. Results on Qwen2.5-VL-7B further demonstrate its applicability across architectures. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/MWOP.
summaryZh: 本文提出了一种名为MWOP（模态感知宽度剪枝）的创新方法，旨在降低多模态大模型（MLLM）的推理成本。研究发现，注意力头及前馈网络（FFN）在处理视觉与文本模态时存在细粒度的冗余。MWOP通过对视觉到视觉、文本到视觉及文本到文本的注意力路径进行独立剪枝，并结合一阶泰勒准则优化FFN通道选择，实现了高效的计算压缩。在LLaVA-OneVision-7B等模型上的实验表明，该方法在保持99.7%性能的同时，实现了1.6倍的预填充加速，并可与现有的Token压缩技术协同工作，进一步提升推理效率。

模型剪枝，通过移除冗余参数或计算路径来降低模型大小与计算量。
前馈神经网络，Transformer架构中的核心计算组件。
